newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds Abbey Life flies on Pru rumours.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds Abbey Life flies on Pru rumours.

text.p: Shares in Lloyds Abbey Life rocketed 42-1/2 pence to 603 pence on Wednesday on market rumours that giant insurer Prudential Corp wanted to make a bid for the company after selling its Mercantile & General unit.

Prudential, on the look out for some time for a building society or life insurer, had said after selling M&G back to Swiss Re for 1.75 billion stg on Tuesday that it was in no hurry to make an acquisition.
Dealers were also sceptical about the rumours around the life insurance group.
Prudential said it did not comment on market rumours.
Dealers doubted the credibility of the bid talk as Lloyds TSB Group Plc owns a 62 percent stake in Lloyds Abbey Life.
"Even if Pru was to mop up every share in the market it still won't have a controlling stake," said one dealer. "There might have been a few badly managed orders out there," said another dealer.
Lloyds TSB also said it did not comment on market rumours.
